summary: The repair-extension execution (receipt 6d6abaf163524e64878c6c9810de2461) scored all five comparisons as predicted: the forgotten voter is missing after the flagged restart (violated, witness 1), a write is applied holding only two of four committed voters (violated, witness 3), both controls hold (indices 7 and 9), and the repair comparison holds at index 5 — with a correctly configured leader in place, a later configuration entry restored the stale node to five members including the forgotten D and the newly added E. The parent interpretation now cites that receipt, records the repair as counterevidence against reading the stale configuration as irrecoverable, and states the boundary that follows: repair needs a correctly configured leader, so it exists where stale nodes are a minority (forgotten-voter case) and not where an empty configuration prevents any leader from being elected (cluster-wide and partial-restart cases). The understate investigation cites the same receipt with joint history explaining the lineage (first execution, repeat, and the successor adding the repair phase), and notes that only the successor carries the repair comparison while the earlier comparisons remain valid witnesses.
